ruleset.name: WordPress Coding Standards for VIP Workflows extensions
ruleset.description:
Shared PHPCS baseline for the workflow-* extension plugins, which ship no ruleset of their own. Single-sources the core plugin's ruleset so the two can't silently diverge (bump the WP floor or add a sniff exclusion once, in vip-workflows/.phpcs.xml.dist, and both follow). The ONLY difference is the text-domain pin: each extension owns a different text domain, so the vip-workflows-pinned i18n sniff is dropped and re-added without a domain.
Invoked per file/dir by tools/code-quality/quality.mjs, which always passes explicit targets — so the inherited `<file>.</file>` and basepath from the core ruleset are inert here.
